title: Beach Blessings Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Rare find in Seagrove right on the gulf, spectactular views! Private beach access!!!
description_expanded: Are you ready to relax and enjoy a taste of old Florida? We invite you to linger over your morning coffee as you greet the day from the swing in the front yard gazebo overlooking the sugar white sands and sparkling emerald water of the Gulf of Mexico. When you reach Seagrove Beach, you will turn off Highway 30-A onto the oyster shell paved road leading to the cul-de-sac containing “Beach Blessings”. This beach-front cottage with beach access allows you the opportunity to experience a get-away reminiscent of yesteryear- the beauty of the seashore in a less-crowded setting. Located two miles from busy Seaside, it is close enough to allow you to easily access the activities, shopping and dining opportunities offered there, but far enough away to allow you to exhale, unwind, relax and de-stress. You will smile to yourself, knowing that when you are ready to walk to the beach, you won’t have to walk across blazing asphalt lugging piles of beach paraphernalia. You will be mere steps away. You will have arrived! This comfortable one-level home sleeps up to 12 people in its four bedrooms. It's perfect for a single family or two families. The sleeping accommodations include: - Master bedroom: king bed and a fold-out twin. There is a flat screen TV & DVD player. - Bedroom #2: queen bed, flat-screen TV. - Bedroom #3: five twin beds, flat screen HDTV. - Bedroom #4: two twin beds. HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Beachfront on the Gulf of Mexico - Amazing views of the “World’s Most Beautiful Beach(es)” - Complimentary wireless high speed internet - Outdoor parking for at least four cars on paved driveway and one in garage - Keyless entry - Well-stocked and fully-equipped kitchen including a ceramic-top range, large pantry, Keurig and standard coffee maker, microwave, dishwasher, full-sized refrigerator with freezer, toaster oven, crock pot, 2 blenders, hand mixer, electric can opener, electric knife - Dining seating for 12: kitchen table seats 8-10, den table seats 4 - Comfortable den seating - Central air-conditioning/ heat (with UV-light to remove allergens) & ceiling fans - Cable HDTV and DVD player - Covered gazebo with swing overlooking the beach - Outdoor patio overlooking beach - Charcoal grill - Games, books, movies and puzzles - Built-in USB port in wall outlet in kitchen for charging cell phone - Indoor stacked front-loading washer and dryer - Outdoor shower OPTIONAL ADD-ONS **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF

all: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
